description: The source describes approximate boundaries of active recreation features in Peel Region. Listed types include sports and recreation centres, arenas, pools, playgrounds, playing fields, golf courses and major parks. CSV, KMZ and ZIP descriptors and a feature-service route are provided. The catalogue reports 2,415 rows and an end date in August 2020, without establishing the current feature count or a common survey date. The concrete infrastructure subjects are recreation buildings and constructed sports facilities; broader parks remain in the published collection. The metadata does not establish capacities, opening hours, condition, geometric precision or landownership. All representations remain grouped as one boundary resource. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue preserves source identifiers and descriptive metadata. Provider: Peel Region. Licence: Open Data Licence for The Regional Municipality of Peel. Costs and current file access are unverified. Access metadata says open; isopen is false. No linked dataset, workbook, document, archive or model/code body was retrieved. Specific simulation applications beyond the stated role are unknown. Related source components retain their own identities.
